sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Gabon visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Gabon, and can apply online for an eVisa before travelling. The approval is then presented on arrival.

sections.heading: Gabon visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Gabon
sections.text: You'll usually need proof of yellow fever vaccination, a return flight booking and details of where you'll stay. We check your documents before applying.

sections.heading: Gabon visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Gabon visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Gabon.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Gabon from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens can apply online for a Gabon eVisa before travelling.

faqs.q: How long does a Gabon visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Gabon visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Gabon visa application and submit it for you.
